transcript: Speaker A: He is my real brother. Speaker B: English mein real brother bolna ajeeb lagta hai. Iska matlab to yeh hua ki baaki sab fake hain. Aapko bas kehna chahiye 'He is my brother' ya 'biological brother'. [Saying 'real brother' in English sounds weird. It implies others are fake. You should just say 'He is my brother' or 'biological brother'.] Speaker A: Hadd hai yaar. Hum Indians to hamesha yahi bolte hain. Aisi kitni cheezein hongi jo main galat bolta hoon. [That's too much. We Indians always say this. I wonder how many things I say incorrectly.] Speaker B: Bohot saari. Par tension lene ki zaroorat nahi hai. Hum natural conversations karenge aur main aisi saari Desi English aaraam se theek kar doongi. [A lot. But no need to worry. We will have natural conversations and I will easily correct all such Desi English.] Speaker A: Par yaar, doston ke saamne aise galat English bolkar beizzati karwane se accha main chup hi rahoon. [But instead of getting embarrassed by speaking wrong English in front of friends, it's better I stay quiet.] Speaker B: Chup bilkul nahi rehna hai. SpeakEasy App par practice karte samay hum dono call par honge. Aap bindaas galat English bolo. Wahaan koi teesra nahi hoga hansne wala. [Don't stay quiet at all. While practicing on the SpeakEasy App, we will be on a call. Speak wrong English freely. There won't be a third person to laugh.] Speaker A: Sahi keh rahi ho. Yeh confidence banane ke liye kitne paise lagenge? [You're right. How much will it cost to build this confidence?] Speaker B: Laakhon logon ne bas ’1 se shuru kiya tha. [Lakhs of people started with just ’1.] Speaker A: Kahan se download karoon? [Where do I download it from?] Speaker B: Install button dabao. SpeakEasy App download karo. Pehle 3 din sirf ’1 mein. Aur fake waali galatiyon se bacho. [Press the install button. Download the SpeakEasy App. First 3 days for just ’1. And avoid fake mistakes.] Speaker A: Haan, zaroor. [Yes, definitely.] Speaker B: To install button par click karo aur SpeakEasy App download karo. [So click on the install button and download the SpeakEasy App.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy App download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
